title: Am belebten Strand
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original high-resolution hidden-person puzzle for a human-versus-AI game.
Create a single full-bleed landscape illustration in 16:9, 1672 by 941 pixels. Crisp clean editorial cartoon, fine precise dark outlines, flat clear colors with subtle shading, sharp tiny faces and clothing, no grain, no blur, no depth-of-field, no pixel art. Elevated three-quarter panoramic view. This must be substantially more crowded and challenging than a scene with thirty people.
Exactly ONE Waldo/Wally: slender adult man, brown hair, round black glasses, red-and-white horizontally striped long-sleeve shirt, red-and-white knit hat with red pom-pom, blue trousers, brown shoes. His complete head, hat, shirt and legs must be visible and anatomically coherent. Give him exactly the same scale, line weight and contrast as his immediate neighbors. He is one ordinary small member of the crowd, roughly 10–13% of image height. Do not place him in a large empty gap or spotlight or at the composition center. Do not create another person with his complete outfit.
Other people wear varied clothes with red jackets, blue trousers, striped shirts in other colors, hats, glasses, bags; these partial similarities make a fair visual search. Distribute lively human activity across the whole frame in many staggered rows. Every figure has a distinct readable head and silhouette; nearby people may overlap each other, but keep Waldo's hat and face unobstructed. Preserve fine detail even in background people. Difficulty comes from crowd density and similar colors, NOT blur or poor rendering.
No lettering, no labels, no watermark, no border, no arrows, no boxes, no circles, no map marker, no visual hint identifying Waldo. Completely original composition, not a copy of a published puzzle.
Scene: A busy sunny seaside boardwalk and sandy beach. At least 65 distinct people walking, carrying beach bags, flying kites, buying ice cream, playing ball, relaxing under striped umbrellas. A boardwalk crosses the lower half and small beach huts sit at the far edge. People fill five or six staggered bands, with varied colors and plenty of red clothing. Waldo walks with a group on the boardwalk, not in the foreground.
